Mar 2022 – Nov 2022
Scrum Master – Apple – Supplier Care Portal - : Infosys |
⚫
Align cross-functional teams with the overall project vision, sprint goals, and
release objectives to ensure seamless execution and delivery.
⚫
Facilitate Agile and Scrum development processes, providing coaching and
mentorship to Agile pods working on PGS projects for continuous improvement
and high performance.
⚫
Identify, communicate, and remove impediments by collaborating with
leadership and stakeholders, ensuring that development teams stay focused
and productive.
⚫
Partner with Product Owners to support backlog refinement, prioritization, and
sprint planning, maintaining clear communication and alignment with business
objectives.
⚫
Plan, schedule, and lead Agile ceremonies (Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning,
Reviews, and Retrospectives) to promote transparency, accountability, and
iterative progress.
⚫
Collaborate closely with stakeholders, Scrum Masters, and project managers to
ensure delivery timelines, KPIs, and milestones are achieved efficiently.
Jun 2019 – Mar 2022
Scrum Master / Kanban Coach – Altria – DMS SFDC - Capgemini
⚫
Introduced Kanban practices, improving delivery flow by 15%.
⚫ Monitored cycle time, lead time, and throughput for performance
optimization.
⚫
Partnered with Product Owners for business value-driven prioritization.
⚫
Facilitated Scrum and SAFe ceremonies including Daily Stand-ups, Sprint
Planning, and PI Planning.
⚫
Coached the API Integration team on Agile and SAFe practices.
⚫
Collaborated with Product Owners, Architects, and RTEs to align on priorities
and dependencies.
⚫
Removed impediments and fostered continuous improvement.
⚫
Tracked team metrics and ensured delivery against PI objectives.
⚫
Supported API lifecycle management and integration best practices.
⚫
Promoted DevOps and CI/CD adoption within the team.
⚫
Enabled cross-team coordination and dependency resolution across the ART.
⚫
Utilized secondary knowledge of API integration.
Mar 2016 – May 2019
QA Analyst – GE -Post Market Quality Management(PQM) - Capgemini
⚫
Stablished, run, and maintain quality processes and management systems.
⚫
Plan and conduct quality audits to ensure compliance and identify areas for
improvement.
⚫ Monitored project execution and track planned activities and actions.
⚫
Identified and assess key risks and control environments associated with
processes and projects.
⚫
Drived continuous improvement initiatives using methodologies such as Six
Sigma and Lean to enhance quality.
⚫
Interact with client teams and support client or third-party audits.
⚫
Designed and executed automation frameworks using Selenium & Java.
⚫
Conducted functional and UAT testing to support Agile delivery.
⚫
Ensured product quality in complex healthcare domain applications.
